monu.translation: abbr. monument 纪念碑，纪念馆

monument.definition: n. an important site that is marked and preserved as public property
monument.translation: n. 纪念碑, 纪念物, 石碑

monumental.definition:
a. relating or belonging to or serving as a monument
s. of outstanding significance
monumental.translation: a. 纪念碑的, 做为纪念的, 不朽的

monumentalism.translation: n. 纪念碑式的建筑，雄伟的建筑; 纪念碑风格

monumentality.translation: 纪念碑状, 纪念碑性, 庞大

monumentalize.definition: v. record or memorialize lastingly with a monument

monumentalized.definition: v record or memorialize lastingly with a monument
monumentalized.translation: v. 纪念, 为…立碑( monumentalize的过去式和过去分词 )

monumentalizes.definition: v record or memorialize lastingly with a monument
monumentalizes.translation: v. 纪念, 为…立碑（monumentalize的第三人称单数形式）

monumentalizing.definition: v record or memorialize lastingly with a monument
monumentalizing.translation: v. 纪念, 为…立碑( monumentalize的现在分词 )

monumentally.definition:
adv. By way of memorial.
adv. By means of monuments.
monumentally.translation: adv. 纪念地, 非常地

monuments.definition:
n. a structure erected to commemorate persons or events
n. an important site that is marked and preserved as public property
n. a burial vault (usually for some famous person)
monuments.translation: n. 纪念碑( monument的复数形式 ); 遗迹; 遗址; 丰碑

monuron.translation: n. 灭草隆(一种除草剂)
